text:
ravi: tiny update: Octavia the chinchilla discovered the plant saucer and turned it into a dust-bath spa. photo: https://i.imgur.com/OctaviaDust.jpg :sparkles:

ella: omg her little ears are aerodynamic. she looks like a powdered cloud. :cloud_tornado:

kevin: official petition to make Fridays "dust-bath hours" in the lounge. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Heads up: please keep animals off shared keyboards during deploy windows (next: Mon 08:00 UTC).

ravi: noted. Octavia will be on the floor, away from keyboards, executing her relaxation routine.

ella: question: is it ethical to put a tiny towel next to the saucer? she might appreciate the luxury. :thinking:

kevin: yes but only if it's embroidered with her name. i'll handle stitching.

ella: also, vote: should we add "Octavia spa" as a recurring micro-event in the calendar? react with :white_check_mark: for yes, :eyes: for no.

ravi: :white_check_mark: yes please

kevin: :white_check_mark: 100% in favor. bringing chamomile-scented sachets for ambiance (human-safe).

ella: giphy time. GIF: chinchilla fluff roll (posted)

ravi: marketing wanted to ask if we can reuse the footage for a short morale reel. tag marketing if you don't want it shared externally.

kevin: i'm ok with company-internal use. no external cuteness exports without consent from pet-owner (i object to piracy).

ella: Octavia sends a tiny twitch as approval. (reacts: :heart: from kevin, :laughing: from ravi)
